questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R)। नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प चुनिए :
अभिकथन (A) : अन्य बातें समान रहने पर, घरेलू मुद्रा के अवमूल्यन से किसी राष्ट्र की राष्ट्रीय आय में वृद्धि होती है।
कारण (R) : स्थिर विनिमय दर प्रणाली के अंतर्गत, किसी राष्ट्र की घरेलू मुद्रा का अवमूल्यन विदेशी मुद्रा के संबंध में घरेलू मुद्रा के मूल्य में कमी को संदर्भित करता है।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements - Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose one of the correct alternatives given below :
Assertion (A): Ceteris Paribus, Devaluation of domestic currency leads to an increase in National Income of a nation.
Reason (R): Devaluation of domestic currency refers to reduction in the value of domestic currency with respect to foreign currency, under the fixed exchange rate system.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are true. Devaluation makes exports cheaper, potentially increasing national income (A). Devaluation is indeed the reduction of currency value under a fixed exchange rate system (R). However, R is not the direct reason for the increase in national income mentioned in A; rather, it is the definition of devaluation.

questions.text: किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में केन्द्रीय बैंक मुद्रा आपूर्ति को _______ में _______ करके कम कर सकता है।
questions.text_english: The Central Bank can reduce the Money Supply in the economy by _______ the ***.
questions.instruction_line: सही विकल्प द्वारा रिक्त स्थानों की पूर्ति करें ।
questions.instruction_line_english: Fill up the blanks with correct alternative.
questions.solution: By increasing the bank rate, the cost of borrowing for commercial banks rises, which reduces the money supply. Thus, the correct sentence is: The Central Bank can reduce the Money Supply in the economy by increasing the bank rate.

questions.text: पहचानें कि, भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था में निम्नलिखित में से कौन विदेशी मुद्रा की माँग का स्रोत नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following is not a source of demand for foreign exchange for Indian economy?

options.B: भारत में रहने वाले विदेशियों द्वारा विदेशों में अपने परिवारों को प्रेषित धन ।
options.C: विदेश यात्रा पर जाने वाले भारतीय पर्यटक ।

options_english.B: Remittances by foreigners living in India to their families abroad
options_english.D: Loans from Rest of the World (ROW)

questions.solution: Loans from the Rest of the World (ROW) represent an inflow of foreign currency (supply), not a demand for it. Imports, remittances sent abroad, and foreign travel by Indians all require the payment of foreign currency, thus creating a demand.
questions.topic: Demand and Supply of Foreign Exchange

questions.text: यदि एक सीधी रेखा उपभोग फलन Y-अक्ष पर सकारात्मक अवरोधन बनाता है, तो इसका तात्पर्य है कि, आय के स्तर में वृद्धि से सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति _______ और औसत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति _______ होगी।
questions.text_english: If a straight line consumption function makes a positive intercept at the Y-axis, it implies that the Marginal Propensity to Consume _______ and Average Propensity to Consume _______ as the level of income rises.
questions.instruction_line: सही विकल्प द्वारा रिक्त स्थानों की पूर्ति करें ।
questions.instruction_line_english: Fill up the blanks with correct alternative.
questions.solution: In a linear consumption function, the slope (MPC) is constant. As income increases, the autonomous consumption component is spread over a larger income, causing the Average Propensity to Consume (APC) to fall. Therefore, MPC remains constant, and APC falls.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से, किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में मुद्रा आपूर्ति की असत्य विशेषता (ओं) की पहचान करें :
(i) इसे एक समय अवधि में मापा जाता है।
(ii) इसमें किसी राष्ट्र की सरकार के पास रखे मुद्रा भंडार को सम्मिलित किया जाता है।
(iii) यह सदैव किसी राष्ट्र के केन्द्रीय बैंक के पास रखी हुई मुद्रा को दर्शाता है।
questions.text_english:
Identify the incorrect feature(s) of the Money Supply in an economy, from the following:
(i) It is measured during a period of time.
(ii) It includes stock of money held by the government of a nation.
(iii) It always represents the currency held with Central Bank of the Nation.
questions.solution: Money supply is a stock concept, not a flow, so (i) is incorrect. It refers only to money held by the public, not by the government or the central bank, making (ii) and (iii) incorrect as well. All three statements are incorrect features of money supply.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R)। नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प चुनिए :
अभिकथन (A) : मौद्रिक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद की तुलना में वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद किसी राष्ट्र की आर्थिक संवृद्धि का बेहतर संकेतक है।
कारण (R) : वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद में वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के मूल्य को वर्तमान वर्ष के मूल्यों पर मापा जाता है।

Read the following statements - Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose one of the correct alternatives given below:
Assertion (A): Real Gross Domestic Product is a better indicator of economic growth of a nation as compared to Nominal Gross Domestic Product.
Reason (R): Real Gross Domestic Product measures the value of goods and services at current year prices.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true because Real GDP removes the effect of price changes. Reason (R) is false because Real GDP is measured at constant (base year) prices, not current year prices. Nominal GDP uses current prices.

questions.text: दी गई तालिका द्वारा, आय के उस स्तर की पहचान करें जहाँ औसत बचत प्रवृत्ति (APS) शून्य होगी:
questions.text_english: From the given table, identify that level of income, where Average Propensity to Save (APS) becomes Zero.
questions.solution: APS is zero when Savings is zero. Since S = Y - C, we look for the level where Y = C. In the table, when Income is 100, Consumption is also 100, meaning Savings = 0. Therefore, APS is zero at an income level of 100.

questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: Consumption and Savings are the components of National output of an economy.
Statement 2: Higher level of Income often leads to lower savings.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

यदि किसी राष्ट्र की सरकार स्फीतिकारी अंतराल की स्थिति को नियंत्रित करने का प्रयास कर रही है, तो निम्नलिखित को सही अनुक्रमिक क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें :

questions.text_english:
Arrange the following in the correct sequential order, if the government of a nation is trying to curtail the situation of inflationary gap:
(i) Decrease in disposable income
(ii) Increase in taxes
(iii) Decrease in Aggregate Demand
questions.solution: To correct an inflationary gap, the government increases taxes (ii). This leads to a decrease in disposable income (i), which ultimately results in a decrease in aggregate demand (iii). Thus, the correct sequence is (ii), (i), (iii).

questions.text:
(a) निम्नलिखित सूचना का उपयोग करते हुए, साधन लागत पर शुद्ध राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (NNP_FC) के मूल्य का अनुमान लगाएँ :
(i) घरेलू उपभोग व्यय: 1,200
(ii) व्यावसायिक स्थायी निवेश व्यय: 800
(iii) सरकारी अंतिम उपभोग व्यय: 500
(iv) निर्यात पर आयात की अधिकता: 100
(v) शुद्ध अप्रत्यक्ष कर: 150
(vi) मालसूची में परिवर्तन: (-) 50
(vii) स्थिर पूँजी का उपभोग: 200
(viii) विदेशों से शुद्ध कारक आय: 80
(ix) सार्वजनिक स्थायी निवेश: 70
questions.text_english:
(a) Estimate the value of Net National Product at Factor Cost (NNP_FC), using the following information:
(i) Household Consumption Expenditure: 1,200
(ii) Business Fixed Investment Expenditure: 800
(iii) Government Final Consumption Expenditure: 500
(iv) Excess of Imports over Exports: 100
(v) Net Indirect Taxes: 150
(vi) Change in Inventory: (-) 50
(vii) Consumption of fixed capital: 200
(viii) Net factor Income from Abroad: 80
(ix) Public fixed investment: 70

key_points: GDP_MP = Private Final Consumption Exp + Government Final Consumption Exp + Gross Domestic Capital Formation + Net Exports
Gross Domestic Capital Formation = Business Fixed Inv + Public Fixed Inv + Change in Inventory = 800 + 70 - 50 = 820
Net Exports = -100
NNP_FC = GDP_MP - Depreciation - NIT + NFIA = 2420 - 200 - 150 + 80 = 2150

questions.solution: GDP at Market Price is calculated by summing Private Final Consumption Expenditure, Government Final Consumption Expenditure, Gross Domestic Capital Formation, and Net Exports. Here, Gross Domestic Capital Formation equals 800 + 70 - 50, which is 820. Net Exports is -100. Thus, GDP at MP is 1200 + 500 + 820 - 100, equaling 2420. To arrive at NNP at Factor Cost, we subtract depreciation (200), subtract Net Indirect Taxes (150), and add Net Factor Income from Abroad (80). The final calculation is 2420 - 200 - 150 + 80, resulting in 2150 crores.

questions.text: भारत के भुगतान संतुलन के अंतर्गत स्वायत्त व समायोजन मदों का सोदाहरण अर्थ बताएँ ।
questions.text_english: State the meaning of autonomous and accommodating items, under Balance of Payments of India, with the help of an example.

key_points: Autonomous items are independent of the balance of payments status, driven by profit motive, e.g., foreign investment.
Accommodating items are undertaken to restore BoP balance, reflecting official flows, e.g., borrowing from IMF.
Autonomous items cause disequilibrium, while accommodating items rectify it.

questions.solution: Autonomous items in the Balance of Payments are transactions driven by the motive of profit, which are independent of the state of the BoP. For example, a firm investing in a foreign country is an autonomous transaction. Conversely, accommodating items are undertaken to bridge the deficit or surplus in the BoP, effectively balancing it. These reflect official government or central bank transactions, such as borrowing from the IMF to cover a trade deficit. Thus, autonomous items create disequilibrium, whereas accommodating items restore balance.

questions.text: मान लीजिए, भारत सरकार ने ₹ 40,000 करोड़ की रक्षा परियोजना के साथ सार्वजनिक निवेश को प्रोत्साहित करने का निर्णय लिया है। अन्य सभी कारकों को अपरिवर्तित मानते हुए, दी गई स्थिति के अर्थव्यवस्था की आय, रोजगार व उत्पादन पर संभावित प्रभावों की व्याख्या करें।
questions.text_english: Suppose, the Indian Government decides to boost public investments with a defence project of 40,000 crore. Explain the likely impacts of the given situation on the Income, Employment and Output of the economy, assuming all other factors constant.

key_points: Increase in government expenditure leads to increase in Aggregate Demand.
Investment Multiplier effect stimulates an increase in income by a multiple of the initial investment.
Increased output to meet higher demand creates new job opportunities.
The multiplier value depends on the Marginal Propensity to Consume.

questions.solution: An increase in public investment of 40,000 crore will directly boost Aggregate Demand in the economy. This initial spending triggers the investment multiplier effect, where the final increase in national income will be a multiple of the initial investment, depending on the Marginal Propensity to Consume. As production increases to meet the rising demand, firms will employ more labor, leading to higher employment levels. Ultimately, this leads to an expansion of total output, fostering economic activity through the circular flow of income and expenditure across various sectors.

questions.text: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक के 'बैंकों के बैंक व पर्यवेक्षक' कार्य की व्याख्या करें ।
questions.text_english: Elaborate the 'Banker's Bank and Supervisor' function of the Reserve Bank of India.

key_points: Banker's Bank: Holds cash reserves of commercial banks, lends them funds during shortages (Lender of Last Resort), and provides clearing house services.
Supervisor: Oversees and regulates commercial banks through periodic audits and licensing to ensure stability.

questions.solution: As the Banker's Bank, the Reserve Bank of India maintains the cash reserves of all commercial banks, providing them with a safe repository for their funds. It also acts as the lender of last resort, offering loans to banks facing temporary liquidity shortages, and facilitates the settlement of inter-bank claims through clearing house functions. In its capacity as a supervisor, the RBI regulates the entire banking system by issuing licenses, conducting periodic audits, and ensuring that banks adhere to established financial norms and safety guidelines, thereby maintaining the stability and integrity of the national financial infrastructure.

questions.text:
(a) मान लीजिए, एक अर्थव्यवस्था संतुलन में है। निम्नलिखित आँकड़ों द्वारा अर्थव्यवस्था में निवेश व्यय की गणना करें।
(i) राष्ट्रीय आय = ₹40,000 करोड़
(ii) सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (MPC) = 0.8
(iii) स्वायत्त उपभोग (c) = ₹100 करोड़
questions.text_english:
(a) Suppose an economy is in equilibrium. From the following data, calculate Investment Expenditure in the economy:
(i) National Income = 40,000 crore
(ii) Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC) = 0.8
(iii) Autonomous Consumption (c) = 100 crore

key_points: Equilibrium condition: Y = C + I
Consumption function: C = c + MPC(Y)

questions.solution: In an economy at equilibrium, the total income Y equals the sum of consumption expenditure C and investment expenditure I. The consumption function is expressed as C = c + MPC(Y), where 'c' is autonomous consumption. Given autonomous consumption is 100 crore and MPC is 0.8, C = 100 + 0.8(40,000), which equals 100 + 32,000, totaling 32,100 crore. Using the equilibrium condition I = Y - C, we calculate I = 40,000 - 32,100, which results in an investment expenditure of 7,900 crore.

questions.text:
(a) निम्नलिखित को मान्य कारणों द्वारा, पूँजीगत प्राप्तियों अथवा राजस्व प्राप्तियों में वर्गीकृत करें :
(i) एक महारत्न कम्पनी से सरकार को प्राप्त लाभांश ।
(ii) खुले बाज़ार में किसी सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उपक्रम (PSU) के अंशों (Share) की बिक्री से सरकार को प्राप्ति ।
(iii) श्रीलंका सरकार द्वारा भारत सरकार को चुकाया गया ऋण ।
questions.text_english:
(a) With valid reasons, classify the following into Capital receipts or Revenue receipts of the government :
(i) Dividend received by the government from a Maharatan company.
(ii) Receipts of the government from sale of shares of a Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) in open market.
(iii) Debt cleared by Sri Lanka Government to the Indian Government.

key_points: Dividend received: Revenue receipt (no liability created, no asset reduced).
Sale of PSU shares: Capital receipt (reduces government assets).
Debt cleared by Sri Lanka: Capital receipt (reduces government assets).

questions.solution: The dividend received by the government from a Maharatan company is classified as a Revenue receipt because it neither creates any liability for the government nor causes any reduction in its assets. The sale of shares of a Public Sector Undertaking in the open market is a Capital receipt, as it involves a reduction in the government's assets (divestment). Finally, the debt cleared by the Sri Lankan government to the Indian government is also a Capital receipt because it leads to a reduction in the government's financial assets, specifically the loan provided by the Indian government.

questions.text: (a) "पिछले कुछ दशकों में, संरचनात्मक ढाँचे में तीव्र वृद्धि से उत्पन्न सकारात्मक बाह्यताओं से भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था काफ़ी लाभान्वित हुई है।" दिए गए कथन को वैध तर्कों द्वारा सिद्ध करें।
questions.text_english: (a) "In the past few decades, Indian economy has been fairly benefitted by positive externalities created by rapid rise in infrastructure." Justify the given statement with valid arguments.

key_points: Better transportation improves market access for farmers and industries.
Enhanced energy and digital infrastructure reduces operational costs and boosts productivity.
Improved connectivity encourages investment and economic integration.

questions.solution: Infrastructure development creates positive externalities that boost overall economic efficiency. Improved transportation networks, such as highways and ports, have significantly enhanced market access, allowing farmers and manufacturers to transport goods faster and more cheaply. Furthermore, advancements in energy and digital infrastructure have reduced operational costs for businesses and increased general productivity across sectors. These infrastructural improvements foster a favorable environment for domestic and foreign investment, leading to greater economic integration and long-term sustainable growth for the Indian economy.

questions.text:

questions.text: (a) "कृषि उपदान सरकारी वित्त पर भारी बोझ डालती है, परन्तु निर्धन व सीमांत कृषकों के लिए यह अति आवश्यक है।" दिए गए कथन का औचित्य सिद्ध करें ।
questions.text_english: (a) "Farm subsidies put a huge burden on the government finances, but are necessary for the poor and marginal farmers." Justify the given statement.

key_points: Subsidies are a fiscal burden because they divert funds from other developmental projects.
They are necessary for small farmers who lack capital to afford modern inputs like seeds and fertilizers.
Subsidies ensure food security and help bridge the income gap for vulnerable farmers.

questions.solution: Farm subsidies represent a significant financial strain on the government, as they consume a large portion of the budget that could otherwise be allocated to infrastructure or education. However, these subsidies are vital for poor and marginal farmers who lack the financial capacity to purchase expensive modern inputs like high-yielding seeds, fertilizers, and irrigation facilities. By reducing production costs, subsidies make modern farming affordable for small-scale farmers, thereby ensuring food security and helping to reduce rural poverty and income inequality within the agricultural sector.

questions.text: स्वतंत्रता उपरांत अवधि में, कृषि में 'बिचौलियों के उन्मूलन' से समता के लक्ष्य को पूरा किया गया था। क्या आप दिए गए कथन से सहमत हैं? वैध तर्कों द्वारा अपने उत्तर का समर्थन करें ।
questions.text_english: Goals of Equity was fully served by 'abolition of the intermediaries' in agriculture in the post-independence period of India. Do you agree with given statement? Support your answer with valid arguments.

key_points: Abolition was a necessary step towards equity by linking tillers directly to the state.
It was not 'fully' successful due to implementation loopholes and powerful landlords bypassing laws.
While it reduced exploitation, regional disparities and land distribution issues persisted.

questions.solution: While the abolition of intermediaries (zamindari system) was a crucial step towards equity by establishing a direct link between tillers and the state, the goal was not 'fully' served. Implementation suffered from significant loopholes, as many powerful landlords exploited legal gaps to retain large tracts of land, often by evicting actual cultivators. Consequently, although the reform successfully reduced some levels of exploitation, it did not achieve complete redistribution of land or eliminate all forms of rural inequality, leaving many landless farmers still marginalized in the agrarian structure.

sub_questions.text: पुत्र प्राथमिकता का औचित्य सिद्ध करें।

key_points: Cultural and economic preference for sons leads to skewed sex ratios.
Gender discrimination results in female infanticide or feticide, causing lower female population.

sub_questions.solution: In India, Pakistan, and China, son preference is deeply rooted in patriarchal social structures and traditional economic systems. This cultural bias has led to gender discrimination and, in extreme cases, female feticide or infanticide. Consequently, the sex ratio in these countries is highly skewed, with significantly more males than females, reflecting a societal trend that values male offspring over female children.

key_points: Degree of civil liberties

questions.text_english:
Elaborate how the economic reforms process of India impacted the following:
(a) Agriculture sector
(b) Industrial sector

key_points: Agriculture: Shifted towards export-oriented crops, reduced investment, and high input costs.
Industrial: Deregulation led to increased competition, foreign investment, and growth in sectors like services and manufacturing.

questions.solution: The economic reforms of 1991 had varied impacts on the Indian economy. In the agriculture sector, reforms led to a reduction in public investment and a rise in input costs, shifting focus towards cash and export-oriented crops at the expense of food security for many. In contrast, the industrial sector benefited from deregulation and the removal of the license raj, which fostered a competitive environment. This encouraged foreign investment and modernization, particularly boosting the services and manufacturing sectors, which significantly contributed to the country's overall economic growth.

sub_questions.text: SDG की उपलब्धि में सामूहिक युद्ध के महत्त्व का उल्लेख व व्याख्या करें।
sub_questions.text_english: State and discuss the importance of collective fight in achieving SDG's.

key_points: Collective action is crucial because global challenges are interconnected.
Pooling resources and sharing knowledge can better address poverty and climate change.

sub_questions.solution: Collective action is essential for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals because modern global crises, such as poverty and environmental degradation, are deeply interconnected and transcend national boundaries. By pooling financial resources, sharing technological innovations, and aligning policy efforts, nations can more effectively address the cascading challenges identified in the 2030 Agenda, ensuring no country is left behind in the pursuit of a sustainable future.

This approach aims to proactively manage health crises through integrated monitoring and collaborative actions, ultimately ensuring a more resilient global health architecture capable of mitigating future threats.

sub_questions.text: कृषि विपणन सुधार के लिए सरकार द्वारा अपनाए गए उपाय।

key_points: Regulation of markets to protect farmers from exploitation by middlemen.
Provision of physical infrastructure like storage facilities, warehouses, and transport.

sub_questions.solution: The government has implemented several measures to improve agricultural marketing, notably the regulation of markets to ensure fair play and protect farmers from exploitation by unscrupulous middlemen. Additionally, the government has invested in building essential infrastructure, such as warehousing and cold storage facilities, which helps prevent post-harvest losses and enables farmers to sell their produce at better prices during off-season periods.

sub_questions.text: ग्रामीण विकास में साख का महत्व।
sub_questions.text_english: Importance of credit in rural development.

key_points: Credit enables farmers to buy modern inputs like seeds and machinery.
It helps farmers sustain during non-harvest periods and reduces dependence on moneylenders.

sub_questions.solution: Credit is a cornerstone of rural development because it provides farmers with the necessary capital to invest in modern agricultural inputs, such as improved seeds, fertilizers, and machinery, which are essential for increasing productivity. Furthermore, access to affordable institutional credit reduces dependence on predatory private moneylenders, providing financial security to farmers during non-harvest seasons and allowing them to focus on long-term agricultural development.
